title: crm verification results, schema_version 1
description: The recorded outcome of each verification requirement of a `crm inventory packages` output, which `crm inventory verify` judges (ADR 0032). A reader refuses an unknown schema_version and ignores a field it does not define.

packages_sha256.description: The packages output these results were recorded against: a SHA-256 over the lines `<file sha256>  <file name>`, index.json first, then each package file in index order. `crm inventory verify` refuses a results file whose value differs.

result.description: One requirement's recorded outcome with its evidence. A pass without evidence is not a pass.

evidence.description: Artifacts the check produced, each a path relative to the results file's folder and its SHA-256.

deployed.description: The deployed artifacts the check exercised: component id (`<kind>:<key>`) and content hash.

negative_control.description: True when the result records a deliberately introduced regression, so its expected outcome is fail.
